title: Memory Governance Domain Scenarios
source_note: Authored synthetic cases based on the repository's scope, provenance, sensitivity, expiry, forgetting, poisoning and audit mechanisms; not real user memories. Every scenario includes an explicit evaluation_mechanism; domain datasets are contextual synthetic cases and do not claim execution of domain-specific policy logic.
